== Notes ==
* Can be chained repeatedly to remove crippled.
* When Illusion of Haste is reapplied while you are still enchanted with Illusion of Haste, the enchantment "ends", cripple is applied, and then the enchantment is reapplied. Therefore it triggers [[Vow of Piety]] and [[Contagion]]. The cripple duration is reduced to just 1 second if using both a [["Swift as the Wind"]] inscription and [[Rune of Restoration]].

== Trivia ==
* This is the only skill not changed at all in Gwen's skill bar in [[The Flight North]] mission.
